# Canvas

> Universal React Native UI kit for iOS, Android, and web. Import from @nannier/canvas.

Repository source snapshot: 4.0.0; not proof of an npm release. Match the installed dependency version before using these APIs.

## Start here

- [Agent onboarding](https://canvas.nannier.com/agents.md): recipes, local skills and installed-version checks.
- [Versioned source reference](https://canvas.nannier.com/ai/4.0.0/index.md): installation, guides and all component pages.
- [Installation](https://canvas.nannier.com/ai/4.0.0/installation.md): required and optional peers, fallbacks and runtime support.
- [Theme](https://canvas.nannier.com/ai/4.0.0/theming.md): boolean props, palettes, surface and ThemeProvider API.
- [Layout](https://canvas.nannier.com/ai/4.0.0/layout.md): parent bounds and responsive composition.
- [Overlays](https://canvas.nannier.com/ai/4.0.0/overlays.md): provider hosting, windows and focus behavior.
- [Catalog](https://canvas.nannier.com/ai/4.0.0/catalog.json): public exports, supported props and source platform notes.
- [Manifest](https://canvas.nannier.com/ai/4.0.0/manifest.json): source hashes and snapshot content hashes.
- [Full source reference](https://canvas.nannier.com/llms-full.txt): concatenated Markdown for this source version.
- [Human docs](https://canvas.nannier.com/components): live examples.
